edits.text: When a user's request maps to or could be interpreted as multiple categories in the routing table, load the skills for all of those categories.
edits.reason: Fixes failures where the agent only loaded one skill for a multi-part request, leading to missing tools.

edits.text: When the user's request involves multiple database updates, the summary provided for confirmation must include the details for every requested action.
edits.reason: Ensures that all requested actions are explicitly listed in the confirmation summary to prevent skipping updates.

edits.text: When the user confirms multiple actions that update the database, perform all confirmed actions before asking if there is anything else.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from stopping after completing only the first of several confirmed database actions.

edits.text: When exchanging a delivered order, ensure the replacement item has different product options (e.g., different color, size, or material) than the original item.
edits.reason: Enforces the policy requirement that exchanged items must have different product options.

not_adopted.reason: The agent failed a specific check, but a more systemic procedural improvement for confirmation summaries was prioritized.
Redundant with the summary requirement for including all requested actions.
The rule repeats the existing policy requirement for listing details and obtaining confirmation.
Less impact than enforcing the 'different product options' policy requirement.
Clarification on contradictions is a general conversational skill not specific to a policy gap.
The summary content rule (a12) addresses the core of the confirmation failure.

output.summary: Improved routing for ambiguous requests, ensured all requested actions are included in confirmation summaries and performed sequentially, and enforced product option differences for exchanges.
